name: dot1qPortVlanHCStatisticsTable
description: A table containing per-port, per-VLAN statistics for traffic on high-capacity interfaces.

.1.3.6.1.2.1.17.1.4.1.1.name: dot1dBasePort
.1.3.6.1.2.1.17.1.4.1.1.description: The port number of the port for which this entry contains bridge management information.

.1.3.6.1.2.1.17.7.1.4.2.1.2.name: dot1qVlanIndex
.1.3.6.1.2.1.17.7.1.4.2.1.2.description: The VLAN-ID or other identifier referring to this VLAN.

.1.3.6.1.2.1.17.7.1.4.7.1.1.name: dot1qTpVlanPortHCInFrames
.1.3.6.1.2.1.17.7.1.4.7.1.1.description: The number of valid frames received by this port from its segment that were classified as belonging to this VLAN. Note that a frame received on this port is counted by this object if and only if it is for a protocol being processed by the local forwarding process for this VLAN. This object includes received bridge management frames classified as belonging to this VLAN (e.g., GMRP, but not GVRP or STP).

.1.3.6.1.2.1.17.7.1.4.7.1.2.name: dot1qTpVlanPortHCOutFrames
.1.3.6.1.2.1.17.7.1.4.7.1.2.description: The number of valid frames transmitted by this port to its segment from the local forwarding process for this VLAN. This includes bridge management frames originated by this device that are classified as belonging to this VLAN (e.g., GMRP, but not GVRP or STP).

.1.3.6.1.2.1.17.7.1.4.7.1.3.name: dot1qTpVlanPortHCInDiscards
.1.3.6.1.2.1.17.7.1.4.7.1.3.description: The number of valid frames received by this port from its segment that were classified as belonging to this VLAN and that were discarded due to VLAN-related reasons. Specifically, the IEEE 802.1Q counters for Discard Inbound and Discard on Ingress Filtering.
